name: band resisted chin up
description: A chin-up with a band adding resistance, building the lats and biceps.
instructions: Anchor a resistance band securely below the bar and loop it around your waist so that it pulls downward as you rise.
Hang from the bar with an underhand grip and a braced trunk.
Pull until your chin clears the bar while keeping the band aligned beneath you.
Lower with control to a full hang and repeat.
